commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /etc/inventory
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
source_host=10.100.230.10
source_file=/etc/inventory/app.conf
destination_dir=/etc/inventory
temporary_file=$(mktemp "$destination_dir/.app.conf.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$temporary_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
rsync --timeout=30 --quiet -e 'ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/etc/inventory-sync/known_hosts -i /etc/inventory-sync/id_ed25519' "inventory-sync@$source_host:$source_file" "$temporary_file"
chown root:root "$temporary_file"
chmod 0640 "$temporary_file"
mv -f "$temporary_file" "$destination_dir/app.conf"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
sha256sum "$destination_dir/app.conf"
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.service <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize inventory application configuration from node1
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
User=root
Group=root
PrivateTmp=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/etc/inventory
ProtectHome=true
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SERVICE
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.timer <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_TIMER'
[Unit]
Description=Run inventory configuration synchronization every five minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=1min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s
Persistent=true
Unit=inventory-config-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_SYNC_TIMER
